name: per-round-score
title: The per-round score the contract asks for, and the record that should carry it
description: ITQ is declared uncomputable for a named reason: no per-round score is persisted, and a convergence decision reads the same whether it started, passed or failed a criterion. Its wouldNeed says the vector should ride on the observation and that this is a decision of its own. Making the decision: the vector belongs on the convergence decision record, which is already written at the round boundary and owned by the contract - not on the observation, which is the resource record
